reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer (packet-only: competency text + rendered samples, no generator source), 2026-07-27 re-review batch

samples_reviewed.question_text: Write the symbol for the seventeenth position.
Write the symbol for the sixteenth position.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency is to 'describe the position of objects using ordinal numbers', yet no object appears in any sample. Seed 42 asks 'Which word describes the 13th position?' and seed 44 asks 'Write the symbol for the seventeenth position.' These are numeral-to-word translations in the abstract; nothing asks which child is thirteenth in the line or which book is seventeenth on the shelf.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Only two sub-skills appear across seeds 42-46: symbol to word (13th, 15th, 16th) and word to symbol (seventeenth, sixteenth). Identifying an object at a named position in an ordered set, and naming the position of a given object in a sequence, are both part of the competency's wording and neither is generated.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The one-clause stems and the ordinal vocabulary on offer - 'thirteenth', 'sixteenth', 'twenty-ninth', 'thirtieth' - are well matched to a Grade 3 Quarter 1 reader, and the word-to-symbol direction at seed 45 ('sixteenth' to 16th) is a reasonable single-step demand.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Beyond the two translation directions there is no variation at all: no ordered list to read positions from, no left-versus-right or front-versus-back starting-point variation, and no ordinals attached to real contexts such as race placings or calendar dates.

competency_alignment.rationale: All five seeds sit within the 13th-to-17th band, so no progression exists from the irregular low ordinals (first, second, third, fifth, ninth, twelfth) through the -teenth family to the decade forms (twentieth, thirtieth) and the compound forms (twenty-first, forty-third). The genuinely hard ordinal spellings are never practised.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The competency's stated ceiling is 100th, but the keyed positions are only 13th, 15th, 16th, 16th and 17th, and even the distractors stop at 'thirtieth' and '30th' (seeds 43 and 45). Nothing above 30 is exercised, so more than two thirds of the stated range - including 100th itself and the compound ordinals 21st, 42nd, 53rd - is untested.
